description:
Get full details for a single transaction by Schwab transaction ID.

Returns the same one-line markdown format as get_brokerage_transactions:

  - **<activityId>** [<type>] <tradeDate> | <symbols/qtys> | Net: $<amount>

Use this when you have a specific transactionId (from
get_brokerage_transactions, a journal entry, or a confirmation) and want
the canonical row rather than scanning a history window.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

transaction_id.description:
The Schwab transaction ID as returned by
get_brokerage_transactions (usually surfaced as `activityId`).

name: schwab_get_brokerage_transaction
title: Transaction details
